grouping_rule: one issue per primary topic; membership assigned in code, never by the model

ISS-access.description: Reviewers report being locked out of accounts unexpectedly, unable to log in after updates, and experiencing account security issues like unauthorized access.
ISS-access.label: Account access failures

ISS-billing.description: Reviewers complain that basic features have been restricted behind premium subscription requirements and express dissatisfaction with mandatory paid upgrades.
ISS-billing.label: Premium paywall frustration

ISS-catalog.description: Reviewers report songs disappearing from playlists and liked songs, while song suggestions lack variety and become repetitive.
ISS-catalog.label: Missing songs and poor recommendations

ISS-downloads.description: Reviewers struggle with downloading songs for offline listening, experience downloaded content being removed after updates or phone changes, and report storage management issues.
ISS-downloads.label: Offline download problems

ISS-other.description: Reviewers describe the app as buggy, unstable, and experiencing deterioration in overall performance and user experience.
ISS-other.label: General app instability

ISS-playback.description: Reviewers experience music stopping mid-playback, pauses between songs, false connectivity errors despite having internet, and difficulty playing songs uninterrupted.
ISS-playback.label: Playback interruptions

ISS-support.description: Reviewers report difficulty reaching support, unhelpful or dismissive customer service interactions, and inaccessible contact channels.
ISS-support.label: Inadequate customer support

ISS-usability.description: Reviewers complain about frequent ad interruptions, aggressive unskippable ads, and disabled shuffle forcing users toward premium subscriptions.
ISS-usability.label: Excessive ads and restrictions
